project.name: Balmalcolm
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 2 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. The closed Muddy Boots offer is not retained as current. Customer parking is not misrepresented as a general public car park. Full-meal value is not used to pad the Eat category.

touristAppeal.label: Notable Stop
touristAppeal.summary: Balmalcolm earns a modest map place through a current speciality café, a distinctive community brewery taproom, a signed public-transport connection and a published 1.9-mile approach walk. Its customer parking is clearly labelled and no neighbouring attraction is borrowed.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access can work for responsible dog visits; venue-specific policies are recorded individually.

visitorHighlights.name: Howe Beer Project Taproom
visitorHighlights.reason: A working independent brewery and community taproom with regular opening, events, snacks and visiting food traders.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Advertised Thursday 4–9pm, Friday/Saturday 2–10pm and Sunday 1–7pm; check events and changes.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Howe Beer Project Taproom is separately assessed for visit depth, distinctiveness, presentation, journey worth, access reliability and evidence quality.
